name: @amykit/plugin-hermes-agent
description: Hermes as the agent, over its one-shot mode and usage report.
author: Nicolas Melo

amy.about: Use it when the agent should be Hermes, run in one-shot mode under a profile of its own so amy never touches your personal Hermes setup. It contributes a harness and a usage reader to agent-relay, so install the relay beside it. amy add prepares the profile and amy doctor checks it.
